name: Stripe
summary: The payments infrastructure behind online commerce—and the next bet on stablecoins.
overview: Stripe’s advantage is the breadth of its payments infrastructure and the ease with which developers can build it into a business. The report argues that billing, tax, fraud prevention, and other services make the relationship harder to replace, while online commerce and stablecoins offer further room to grow.

bull_case: A broad payments platform can compound through volumes, software, and financial services.
bear_case: Payments is competitive, cyclical, and sensitive to take-rate pressure.

intelligence.description: Stripe provides payments and financial infrastructure for internet businesses, from checkout to billing and revenue operations.
company: Stripe provides payment processing, billing, tax, fraud prevention, and financial tools to businesses operating online. The breadth of that stack makes Stripe more embedded than a standalone payments gateway.

Stripe announced a tender offer at a $159 billion valuation in February 2026. Its annual letter said businesses on its platform generated $1.9 trillion in payment volume in 2025, up 34% year over year.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Stripe is a core financial-infrastructure company for private software, consumer, and AI businesses. Its payment volume and product expansion are a useful read-through for internet commerce and venture-backed company formation.

changed.text: Stripe is founded to simplify online payments for developers.
Valuation reaches $95 billion as internet payments scale rapidly.
A financing and cost reset focus attention on durable economics.
A $159 billion tender offer reflects renewed confidence in growth and operating leverage.

takeaways: Stripe compounds through payments, software, and financial services.
Payment volume is a scale measure, not company revenue.
Private-company liquidity provides a more current valuation signal than the last primary round.
Stablecoins and AI commerce are potential new growth vectors.
